title: Checkout database connection pool exhausted
description: Customers on the checkout page are seeing intermittent 'unable to complete order' errors. Application logs show the checkout service repeatedly failing to acquire a connection from the primary database pool during a traffic spike.

events.description: Rolled out checkout-service v2.14.0 (raised default query timeout, no pool size change)
Request rate 4.2x above 7-day baseline (flash sale campaign)
